name: OSReward HD hub redraw
generationType: New high-definition redraw based on the official mascot; not an original official release asset and not a pixel upscale.

references.role: Identity and composition reference (attached as the 768 px source OS-Shepherd-logo-v3.png)

prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE image, then save it into this repository at assets/logos/osreward-hd.png (create nothing else in the repo).

Task: a new high-definition redraw of the attached official OSReward / OS-Shepherd mascot, for the OS-Copilot hub's project index, where every project has a ~1254x1254 HD mascot on a transparent background (see assets/logos/openmobile-2-hd.png and assets/logos/os-genesis-hd.png for the target finish and line quality).

Keep the identity exactly: the same small round white robot with a glossy navy visor, two large glowing cyan eyes, cyan ear discs, short antenna with a ball tip, sitting and holding a dark green tablet that shows a radar sweep. Keep the same surrounding motifs and their positions: a green target/crosshair top-left, a dark chart card with a rising green line top-right, a white checklist card with green checks on the left, green bar chart bottom-right, thin dashed connector lines. Same cheerful 3D-illustration style, white/navy/cyan/green palette.

Improve only quality: crisp clean edges, refined shading and material, consistent lighting, sharper small details, balanced composition centred in a square canvas with comfortable margins so it reads at 46 px and at 256 px.

Requirements: square 1:1, fully transparent background (no backdrop, no shadow plate, no frame), no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Do not change the character into a different robot.

After saving, report the output path and its pixel dimensions.

preserved: Seated white robot with navy visor and cyan eyes
Target, line-chart card, checklist and bar chart in their original positions
White, navy, cyan and green palette
